::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" appearance="simple"}
## How review works

Each exercise sits in one of five boxes. Box 1 comes back the same day, box 2 after one day, box 3 after 3, box 4 after 7 and box 5 after 21 days.

- **Easy:** one box up (only with fewer than 2 hints)
- **Okay:** box stays
- **Hard:** one box down
- **Not solved** (solution viewed): back to box 1

Before checking you rate how sure you are. If you are sure and still wrong, you get the full explanation right away: such errors are especially memorable. Cards from different lessons are mixed.
:::
